desc:
🐺 Welcome to Wolves' Life 3! 🐺

"Awooo!" Welcome to the world of Wolves! 

🌲 Explore forests, mountains, beaches, and more.
🎩 Customize your wolf with unique colors, markings, and accessories.
🤝 Meet new friends, form packs, and create unforgettable memories.
🛖 Claim your own wolf den and make it your home.
🍖 Hunt for food, survive in the wild, and defend your territory.
☀️ Experience the world through changing atmospheres and immersive environments.

🔔 IMPORTANT NOTICE:
Wolves' Life 3 is being developed by a small team. We’re working hard to deliver frequent updates, improvements, and bug fixes.

Tags: Wolf Roleplay, Open World, Adopt
